items.quote: The Aura API uses OAuth 2.0 for API authentication.
items.why: Confirms OAuth 2.0 for Aura API; says nothing on basic or bearer_token.

items.quote: Authentication to the token endpoint uses HTTP Basic Authentication, where the client ID and client secret are provided as the username and password, respectively.
items.why: Describes Basic auth at token endpoint; matches one method, not the full list.

items.quote: All tiers can create Aura API credentials.
items.why: Directly says all tiers can create credentials, the self-serve gate.

items.quote: No credit card or other payment method required
items.why: No card needed supports the free-tier part, not credential creation itself.

items.quote: The Aura API allows you to programmatically perform actions on your Aura instances without the need to log in to the Console.
items.why: Shows programmatic instance actions; does not establish REST or moderate breadth.

items.quote: The Query API allows to execute Cypher statements against a Neo4j server through HTTP requests.
items.why: Query API runs Cypher over HTTP; claim's key point is REST breadth, not Query API.

items.quote: The bearer token is obtained from your identity provider and passed to Neo4j for authentication.
items.why: About bearer token from identity provider; says nothing on MCP server existence or vendor.

items.quote: Authentication runs through the Aura Console using a human-in-the-loop OAuth redirect.
items.why: About Aura Console OAuth login flow; does not establish server existence or vendor-official status.
